title: eludite.agents.review output
description: The changes decided and what the applier did. Accepting a change to a closed file writes it off the UI thread, so from the UI thread a change can still be `applying`; from another thread the call waits up to 5 s for the outcome.

state.description: `applying`: accepted, being written; `accepted`: applied; `rejected`: discarded; `failed`: the applier refused it (the document changed since the agent proposed it, see `message`).

tool_call.description: The agent's tool call that proposed it (the ACP toolCallId when known).

message.description: Why nothing was decided (no such change, nothing pending).
